# Mattenii aurora shader provenance

## Identity

- Original page: https://www.shadertoy.com/view/MsjfRG
- Creator: Mattenii
- License stated in the retained shader header: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/
- Immediate source inspected by Wildfires: TFC Caelum 1.2 `assets/minecraft/shaders/aurora.frag`
- Verified on: 2026-08-11

## Use in Wildfires

- Classification: adapted shader.
- Destination: `src/main/resources/assets/wildfires/shaders/core/aurora.fsh`.
- Changes: adapted from TFC Caelum's split shader to Minecraft's Forge-managed GLSL 150 pipeline and the `wildfires` namespace, then modified for Wildfires rendering behavior.
- The destination retains the creator, original URL, license and adaptation statement in its header.

No original mod README or separate license file accompanied this file in the inspected TFC Caelum release. Do not remove the in-file notice. Because CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 is non-commercial and share-alike, release compatibility needs an explicit review rather than relying only on Wildfires' mod-level MIT metadata.
